rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_supervised-claude-agentic: proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=7, proj_kernel=3, proj_sx=0.01, proj_sy=0.3, proj_sr=0.0005, img_kernel=5, img_sx=0.5, img_sy=0.5, img_sr=0.02, epochs=10, batch_size=1, lr=0.005, optimizer=adam, lambda_neg=1.0, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=400, val_n=200, val_chunk=10, seed=42, rationale=iter-3 dual_domain_bilateral_supervised, re-split Breast-CT val=200. SIX-BOX vs BEST (iter-2 img_n_bf=3 hr=0.2431; iter-1 img_n_bf=1 hr=0.2158). (1) PRIOR: deepening the image BF stack is the lever -- 1->3 gave +0.027 hr; OLD-split TPE best used img_n_bf=7. (2) Failure: image effective RF still too small for sparse-view streaks at 3 BFs. (3) ONE KNOB: img_n_bf 3 -> 7 (proj/kernels/lr/epochs held). (4) HYPOTHESIS: 7 chained image BFs (TPE-favored depth) enlarge effective RF and lift hr above 0.2431 toward ~0.26; params ~24 still tiny. (5) BUDGET: 7 cheap 5x5 BF passes << 20 min. (6) iter-4 pivots to epochs/img_kernel if depth saturates. Artifacts saved.
